tools.description: Health check for the integration key. Returns the channel clientId. Call once after connecting to verify the key works.
tools.name: ping

tools.description: Submit a batch of property listings (up to 500) for import. The engine diffs the batch against the channel current stock and plans creations, updates, archivals and deletions; quotas and safety thresholds are enforced server-side. ALWAYS start with mode=DRY_RUN: it queues a plan without changing anything. Read the plan via get_run and list_events, show the summary to the human manager, and only after their explicit confirmation repeat the same call with mode=APPLY. Each element of properties mirrors the REST property draft body; use get_property_vocabulary for every closed vocabulary and limit, search_projects to resolve projectId (a string like PJ-a1b2c3d4, numbers are rejected), list_responsibles to resolve responsibleUsername. Returns the runId of the queued run.

isRemovalConfirmed.description: A run that would archive or delete more than the safety share of the current stock stops with an error; pass true to confirm the removals are intended.

mode.description: DRY_RUN plans without applying; APPLY executes. Never APPLY without human confirmation of the DRY_RUN plan.

items.description: One listing. externalPropertyId is the stable id in YOUR system; the rest mirrors the REST property draft body (title, description, category, listingType, price, squareArea, projectId as the string from search_projects, responsibleUsername, permitNumber, images, ...). get_property_vocabulary lists every closed vocabulary and limit.

tools.name: sync_properties

tools.description: Fetch one import run by runId: status, counters of planned and applied decisions, stop reason if the run did not finish.
tools.name: get_run

tools.description: List this channel import runs, newest first. Paginated.
tools.name: list_runs

tools.description: Per-property outcomes of import runs: what happened to each externalPropertyId, with error codes and details. propertyId is our listing id (PP-...) when the outcome addressed a live listing, propertyDraftId when it addressed a draft. Filter by runId and/or externalPropertyId. Paginated.
tools.name: list_events

tools.description: Resolve a development project to the projectId string (PJ-a1b2c3d4) required by every listing in sync_properties. Search by name fragment (min 2 characters) or by exact DLD project number (digits-only query). Only projects the import would actually accept are returned.
tools.name: search_projects

tools.description: List agency members that can be responsible for a listing or a lead: pass an element username as responsibleUsername; match your users to members by the lowercase email.
tools.name: list_responsibles

tools.description: Every closed vocabulary and limit of the import payload in one call: categories, listing types, building statuses, rental periods, occupancy statuses, currency codes, area units, property features, bedroom counts, payload limits.
tools.name: get_property_vocabulary
